subject: Migration of google group to GGIR GitHub Discussion page?

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Migration of google group to GGIR GitHub Discussion page?
parts:
Hello GGIR google group members,

For a long time this google group has been a valuable place for you to ask questions and report problems.

With the introduction of [GitHub Discussion](https://github.com/wadpac/GGIR/discussions) a couple of years ago, GitHub seems to offer a better platform for Q&A. For example, more functionality for you to have discussions and help each other without my involvement, and more moderation options.

I hereby would like to announce that I am planning to migrate to that platform by updating all GGIR guidance about finding help and at some point disable new posts in this google group.

If anyone here has a concerns or question about this plan then please let me know.

Thanks,

Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
